This pass is the first against a Docker Dark reference: the shipped default moved from Y2K Dark square, and both sides were recaptured together. Measured by ImageMagick MAE against the recaptured reference, then all twenty-one diffs were read as two contact sheets — good for catching a fault of kind (geometry that has shifted, a panel that has vanished, content clipped) rather than a pixel census. None is present in any state: tables, tabs, cards, charts and buttons align on both sides.
